**TL;DR** — A critical unauthenticated RCE (CVE-2026-59774, CVSS 9.8) in self-hosted Gitea is under active-exploit risk for anyone running a public repo — patch to 1.27.1 now.

## Anthropic and Claude
- **Claude Opus 5** launched Jul 24 — new flagship tier tuned for long-running agents plus coding/professional-work gains. [Anthropic News](https://www.anthropic.com/news)
- **Claude Sonnet 5** launched Jun 30 — "frontier performance across coding, agents, and professional work at scale" at the mid tier. [Anthropic News](https://www.anthropic.com/news)
- **Claude Code 2.1.224** (Aug 7) — added `claude self-hosted-runner` for Team/Enterprise, cross-session `SendMessage` (sessions can now message each other, used in this very digest run's tooling), and zip-over-HTTPS plugin installs with SHA-256 pinning. [Claude Code changelog](https://code.claude.com/docs/en/changelog)
- **Claude Code 2.1.223** (Aug 6) — fixed a Bash permission-bypass via crafted commands and a workflow-script sandbox escape via dynamic `import()`; worth updating if you run Code with restricted permissions. [Claude Code changelog](https://code.claude.com/docs/en/changelog)
- **Fable 5** biology safeguards strengthened (Aug 7), following its Jul 1 global redeployment after the export-control lift. [Anthropic News](https://www.anthropic.com/news)

## NixOS ecosystem
- Quiet week — nothing new since the blog's last post. Current state of play: **NixOS 26.05 "Yarara"** (released May 30) remains the stable branch, and the Foundation's documentation-funding push (posted Jul 10) is still open. [NixOS Blog](https://nixos.org/blog/)

## AI coding agents and agent frameworks
- **Meta launched Muse Code** (Aug 5) — a terminal coding agent powered by new Muse Spark 1.2 model, with parallel subagents in isolated git worktrees; pricing is $1.25/$4.25 per M tokens standard, or a steep $0.10/$0.20 discount if you opt into Meta training on your code. *(Outside approved list — via Meta AI Research blog, surfaced through a Daring Fireball-adjacent search, not a DF link itself.)* [Meta AI Research](https://research.meta.ai/blog/introducing-muse-code-and-muse-spark-1-2)
- **Boris Cherny (Anthropic) directed Claude to rewrite Anthropic's desktop app in Swift** over two weeks — Gruber wrote it up skeptically, questioning whether the approach holds up at scale. [Daring Fireball](https://daringfireball.net/)
- **Cursor "DuneSlide" flaws** (CVE-2026-50548/50549, CVSS 9.8) — zero-click prompt-injection chain let attackers escape Cursor's sandbox for full RCE; fixed in Cursor 3.0 (Apr 2) with a symlink fix following Jun 1 — flagging now as it's still circulating in security roundups. *(Outside approved list, unverified beyond secondary security-news coverage.)* [The Hacker News](https://thehackernews.com/2026/07/critical-cursor-flaws-could-let-prompt.html)

## Self-hosting and homelab
- **Critical Gitea RCE — CVE-2026-59774** (disclosed ~Aug 2, CVSS 9.8): unauthenticated attacker can hit a public repo's markup-rendering endpoint (Org-mode `#+INCLUDE`) to read arbitrary files, chainable to RCE via `INTERNAL_TOKEN` extraction. Affects 1.22.1–1.27.0; fixed in **1.27.1**. Not yet on CISA's KEV list but treat as urgent if any repo is public-facing. *(Outside approved list.)* [Gitea Security Advisory](https://github.com/go-gitea/gitea/security/advisories/GHSA-6v53-hr58-556r)

## Local and on-device LLM inference
- **Ollama v0.32.4–v0.32.6** (Jul 25–Aug 4) — deepened MLX-engine integration on Apple Silicon: Laguna model support, an MLX Metal quality bug fix for NVFP4 output, and faster Qwen3.5 speculative decoding via MTP heads. *(Outside approved list.)* [Ollama Releases](https://github.com/ollama/ollama/releases)
- **MiniMax H3 GGUF/NVFP4 community quants** appeared on Hugging Face Aug 3, a day after the open-weights drop, packing the 33.1B omni-modal model into consumer-GPU-sized files. *(Outside approved list; single aggregator source, unverified.)*
